title: Clem Intro

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Hey! Welcome to the Greenhouses. Are you new?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey! Welcome to the Greenhouses. Are you new?

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Well, glad to have you here. So you don't need any help to get started?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, glad to have you here. So you don't need any help to get started?

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Then welcome to the wonderful world of crops. We'll have you harvesting your own food in no time. What would you like to grow first?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then welcome to the wonderful world of crops. We'll have you harvesting your own food in no time. What would you like to grow first?

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Good choice. Onions are easy-going. All you need is some seed, a grow module and time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good choice. Onions are easy-going. All you need is some seed, a grow module and time.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Yeah, inside the greenhouse. There are different modules for different kinds of crops. You can upgrade them as you go... but that's a little advanced for now. These seeds should get you started.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, inside the greenhouse. There are different modules for different kinds of crops. You can upgrade them as you go... but that's a little advanced for now. These seeds should get you started.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Plenty of vendors around the place. Try over by the water. These seeds should get you started.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Plenty of vendors around the place. Try over by the water. These seeds should get you started.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Straight in at the deep end, eh? Listen, mushrooms are... fussy. Try something easier.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Straight in at the deep end, eh? Listen, mushrooms are... fussy. Try something easier.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Onions. With those, all you need is seed, a grow module and time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Onions. With those, all you need is seed, a grow module and time.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: My pleasure. Head on up the hill and check out Thaddeus's old greenhouse. You can take over the rent. Have a go at planting and harvesting your first crop. Seriously, there's nothing better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My pleasure. Head on up the hill and check out Thaddeus's old greenhouse. You can take over the rent. Have a go at planting and harvesting your first crop. Seriously, there's nothing better.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: Woah, slow down hot shot. Can't fly before you can crawl. You need to learn the basics first.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Woah, slow down hot shot. Can't fly before you can crawl. You need to learn the basics first.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: OK, if you know what you are doing, head on up the hill and check out Thaddeus's old greenhouse. You can take over the rent. Have a go at planting your first crop of onions with these seeds. Seriously, there's nothing better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: OK, if you know what you are doing, head on up the hill and check out Thaddeus's old greenhouse. You can take over the rent. Have a go at planting your first crop of onions with these seeds. Seriously, there's nothing better.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: He said someone would be by. He also said you don't know one end of a spade from another. That true?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He said someone would be by. He also said you don't know one end of a spade from another. That true?
I guess I am.

nodes.speaker: Clem Hortelano
nodes.text: You're here for Thaddeus's place, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're here for Thaddeus's place, right?
Afraid so.
Hey! "Green-finger" is my middle name.
Onions.
Mushrooms.
Cultivated Meat.
Module?
Where do I buy seeds?
Like what?
Thanks Clem.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I might need a little help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I might need a little help.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I might need a little help.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I might need a little help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I'm good.
How did you know?
